name: Default
shortDescription: Zigbee to MQTT bridge with a web frontend, using a network-attached Zigbee coordinator and an existing MQTT broker.

alerts.message: Requires a network-attached Zigbee coordinator reachable from the server (for example tcp://192.168.1.12:6638) and an existing MQTT broker. USB adapters cannot be used.
The onboarding page is open to anyone until it is submitted, so complete it right after deploying. The frontend then asks for the ZIGBEE2MQTT_CONFIG_FRONTEND_AUTH_TOKEN value.
